original_intent: Evaluation pilot, not a production invoice feature: enter repeated synthetic invoice identifiers, save each identifier once in first-appearance order, open the persisted export, and reopen it to verify the saved result. Prove the browser-to-HTTP-to-SQLite-to-readback journey with every step visible. This bounded pilot verifies Deepmode recording and replay, not the user's entire broader Deepmode improvement request.
